title: Aaron Weber | Signature Dish (Full Comedy Special)
description:
Aaron Weber debuts his first special ‘Signature Dish’, Executive Produced by Nate Bargatze and Nateland Entertainment.

Directed by Mike Lavin and filmed at The Lab at Zanies in Nashville, Weber dives into his troubles with drywall and raccoons, along with his admiration for Tums, Urgent Care and the absolutely perfect hot dog.
